item.title: I❤️BJ #Beijing🥟🐼
item.description:
I❤️BJ #Beijing🥟🐼

I wasn’t sure what to expect from visiting Beijing, but now I have visited, I want you to know it was so much more than just The Great Wall of China! I was fortunate enough to visit some of the sights including Tian’anmen Square, colourful and bustling food markets, and beautiful gardens. I absolutely fell in love with the #ForbiddenCity and next time I go back, I’d love to see the Summer Palace also- I wish I’d had more time!

Beijing is a unique, interesting and beautiful place, rich with ancient history of Emperors and Dynasties; textures and vibrant colours.

What stood out most to me, was the kindness of strangers willing to help despite language barriers and awkward translation apps. Everyone I met truly was so charmingly sweet, considerate and patient (despite one grumpy taxi driver - but that was my mistake and misunderstanding)

Seeing pandas was obviously a highlight, and on my next trip to China, I hope I can make it to Chengdu and see even more! It’s impressive that through conservation work, the giant pandas have been brought back from extinction and are no longer listed as an endangered species. 🥹🐼

Instagram posts only allow 20 slots on the feed, and it was so difficult to narrow the pics down for this post! I’ll be adding more to my stories to make a highlight on my profile if you’re curious to see more.

All photos of people in these pictures were taken with permission, their traditional dresses were absolutely breathtaking. I was channeling my inner empress energy, in awe of how beautiful they are.

If you have any questions or recommendations, I’d love to answer them in the comments!

#北京 #China #Panda

item.description:
Egypt trip part 1 - my feed is about to get very Egyptian🇪🇬🤍🔺 this is just a few of my fave pics I’ve gone thru so far - my camera roll is HEAVING!

This was a bucket list trip I finally got to experience - and experience it I did! Thanks to @annathropology and @advil who you will see translating hieroglyphics on the last slide 🙀

If it wasn’t for this beautiful couple organizing such a perfect group trip I never would’ve been able to have this trip of a lifetime. I am forever thankful - saving more thoughts and words for the incoming content because tbh I’m still processing the magnitude of the things I have seen. 🐪

#Egypt #pyramids #sphinx #Shukran #pyramid
